hypothesis: Under the exact locked Residual-MLP Gaussian-shift protocol, the compiled frozen recursive hierarchy without teacher-residual correction (P0) is non-inferior to the C63R-confirmed QR-P2 correction condition within the preregistered validation and NMSE margins.

architecture.base_recursive_hierarchy: same C61R-C64R construction: four TinyRes(64,8) locals -> two retrained pairs -> two TinyRes(64,16) compressors -> Chain

distribution_shift.pairing: P0 and P2 within each model seed use exactly the same shifted calibration and validation tensors

calibration.subset_rule: same protocol-fixed clean-training subset rule as C61R-C64R

conditions.P0: frozen base recursive hierarchy compiled directly; no teacher residual correction and no top-boundary adaptation
conditions.P2: first 2 columns of canonical QR of shifted-calibration teacher residual transpose, then top-boundary adaptation to frozen_base_output + residual projection

adaptation.P0: skip top-boundary adaptation entirely; compile frozen base hierarchy

eligibility.eligible_if: runner completes, exact recursive parameter-budget invariant holds, and P0/P2 validation accuracy and NMSE metrics are finite with positive NMSE

validation_noninferiority.statistic: paired P0 minus P2 shifted-validation accuracy
validation_noninferiority.pass: paired percentile bootstrap 95% lower bound > -2.0 percentage points

nmse_ratio.statistic: geometric mean of paired P0/P2 NMSE ratios

primary_decision.overall: C65R_CONFIRMATORY_PASS iff eligible_count >= 8 and both primary gates pass; otherwise STOP_INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE or C65R_CONFIRMATORY_FAIL; no rescue analysis changes this decision

analysis_boundary.scope: exact C65R Residual-MLP recursive-hierarchy Gaussian-sigma=0.04 protocol only
not_supported_even_if_pass: zero-dimensional correction is a universal minimum interface
